summary: Automations: modules/automations provides its engine as engine.RunStarter whenever the composition runs the engine, so start_automation and run_automation start child graphs in an assembled application (before, they always failed with runs_unavailable). The end node takes output (name → CEL), which becomes the run's output and what run_automation reads as nodes.<id>.output.output; a graph version may declare output_schema (JSON Schema of type object), checked against every end node on save (required names, closed schemas, CEL types) and against the computed values when the run ends (INVALID_OUTPUT). An end without output keeps giving its params, as before.
